description: A rounded box whose four border sides are four colors: the sides meet along the diagonal of each corner, so the arc of a corner is split between them and none of it is left unpainted.

florui.css: .box { width: 60px; height: 60px; background-color: #2c352f; border-width: 6px; border-style: solid; border-color: #f0dc9c #6c5224 #1e3a8a #c0392b; border-radius: 26px; }

classification.reason: Chromium's and tiny-skia's anti-aliasing of a curved edge never agree pixel for pixel, and the seam between two colors is a pixel wide in both. Measured against desktop Chrome: 3.70% of pixels differ, geometry an exact match; with the corners left unpainted 6.67% differ, so the threshold tells the two apart.
